name: onlinesourdough-skills

source_boundary.history_strategy: single publish-safe clean-root commit with no parent

atlas.endpoint_continuity: The existing onlinesourdough/Skills repository remains canonical; publication does not rename, archive, replace, or duplicate it.
atlas.candidate_boundary: The repository remains private and Build does not claim that the live Atlas integration works; both public access and Atlas behavior require post-Ship verification.

history_visibility.ordinary_refs: refs/heads/main and refs/heads/codex/issue-33-cross-harness-portability converge on the verified clean-root candidate
history_visibility.historical_release: v0.1.0 release and tag are withheld/deleted and must not be recreated
history_visibility.github_managed_residue: refs/pull/2/head and refs/pull/3/head plus unreachable old objects and cached diffs/views remain blocked pending GitHub Support purge confirmation
history_visibility.canonical_endpoint_action: Keep the existing onlinesourdough/Skills repository private and in place; do not rename, archive, replace, duplicate, or move it.
history_visibility.support_gate: No visibility change, v0.2.0 tag, or GitHub release is legal until GitHub Support confirms purge and the private-state re-audit passes.

marketplace.ship_requirement: After GitHub Support confirms purge and private re-audit passes, create v0.2.0 from the reviewed candidate at the existing canonical endpoint and verify it before presenting installation as available.
marketplace.install_scope: explicit project or isolated fixture unless the user intentionally selects a wider scope
marketplace.recovery: remove this plugin or its exact project-local skills; no public rollback tag exists before v0.2.0 and v0.1.0 must not be recreated

codex.marketplace_add: codex plugin marketplace add onlinesourdough/Skills --ref v0.2.0
codex.candidate_proof: isolated local Git commit/ref fixture only; no v0.2.0 tag or public installation is claimed during Build

skills_cli.install: npx skills@1.5.23 add onlinesourdough/Skills#v0.2.0 --skill clarify manage-skills orchestrate-workers route-models shape-offer --agent claude-code cursor -y
skills_cli.candidate_proof: disposable project and local clean-commit fixture with telemetry disabled; no global or consumer-repository write

distribution.model_execution_boundary: Candidate install/discovery, lock/ref, and byte-hash evidence does not claim model-backed behavior for logged-out or otherwise untested Claude Code and Cursor Agent runtimes.

ship_gate: lead Review accepted the complete r2 candidate and the owner authorized the exact r3 in-place sanitization
both authorized ordinary branch refs resolve to the independently verified clean-root candidate
the v0.1.0 GitHub release and local/remote tag are absent and must not be recreated
Skills issue metadata #1, #4, #5, #6, #7, and #8 contains no blocked private references or inventory
GitHub Support confirms purge of refs/pull/2/head, refs/pull/3/head, unreachable old objects, cached diffs, and cached views
a private-state re-audit reports zero blocked findings across every ordinary and managed ref, object, issue, release, cached diff, and cached view
the existing onlinesourdough/Skills repository remains private and the only canonical endpoint until every preceding gate passes
a later exact Ship authority changes candidate metadata to released state with the actual date and creates immutable v0.2.0 from the reviewed commit
anonymous API, HTTP, Git, Atlas, Codex, and Skills CLI readback passes before any public availability claim
